# Rent 365

> Rent 365 is an Android app for house owners and landlords in India. It tracks properties, units, tenants and monthly rent, sends PDF receipts and invoices to tenants on WhatsApp, adds electricity and water meter readings and shared repair costs to bills, carries advances and dues forward, and backs up to the user's own Google Drive. Free for one property; Pro costs ₹60 a month or ₹600 a year.
